system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The Genwa clan specializes in utilizing the information that electrical signals transmit, acting as information gatherers as the shinobi world utilizes more modern technology such as radio, Ninja-Net or computers. You’ve learned two different forms which enable you to manifest this information in a destructive way. Your Uplink and Downlink stances. These are separate stances, and you can spend a Bonus action to enter or switch to one of these stances.

Uplink. You have electrical energy radiating off of you, that glows in a neon color your choice. While in this Chakra stance you gain the following benefits;

You can utilize the Angel Link effect of your Hijutsu.

Genwa Hijutsu you cast can originate from any space or creature that is currently Signal Boosted.

When you take the attack action, while in this stance, you can replace attacks made with this action with a Radiant Beam attack.

Radiant Beam. Make ranged Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 30 feet of you firing a blast of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu modifier in lightning damage. If you roll an 8 on the damage die of this attack, you or an allied creature within 30 feet of the target becomes Signal Boosted until the end of your next turn. Increase the range of this attack to 60 feet at 7th level and the damage you deal to 2d8 + your jutsu bonus at 15th level. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.

Downlink. You manifest a neon weapon formed of light, that glows in a color your choice. While in this Bukijutsu stance you gain the following benefits;

You can utilize the Demon Link effect of your Hijutsu.

Genwa Hijutsu you cast that affects a creature with ranks of Shocked converts 1 rank of the affected creatures Shocked condition into the Firewalled condition.

Melee weapons you wield that you are proficient in become wreathed in a neon light, infusing them with your unique nature release variant. When you take the attack action using this weapon, you can replace the attacks made with a Radiant Saber attack.

Radiant Saber. Make melee Jutsu attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 5 feet of you, as you strike with a beam of light like energy formed from your lightning release. On a hit, you deal your [Weapon Damage] as lightning damage depending on your weapons damage dice, the affected creature becomes Firewalled until the end of your next turn. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action. Beginning at 15th level, increase critical threat range of these attacks by +1.

d4: On a roll of 3 or 4

d6: On a roll of 5 or 6

d8: On a roll of 7 or 8

d10: On a roll of 9 or 10

d12: On a roll of 11 or 12
